calculation.description: Fades an instrument's five-day return relative to the contemporaneous universe median, scaling by its 20-day return volatility. Higher values indicate stronger relative underperformance and therefore expected short-horizon rebound; the factor is used as a long-only ranking input.

validation.regime_notes: Daily admission metrics pass the benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840). Valid observations are concentrated in the recent common-history sample; regime subperiod attribution before 2025 is unavailable because fewer than eight valid dates were produced. Uncertainty is therefore high despite full 15-instrument cross-sections.
